title: cordemoya subpeltata
intro: Cordemoya subpeltata, commonly known as the monkey tree or monkey apple, is a species of flowering plant in the family Annonaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to protect against cell damage, reduce inflammation, and prevent infections. The therapeutic actions of Cordemoya subpeltata include wound healing, antimicrobial activity, and anti-hyperglycemic effects, making it a potential natural remedy for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, phenolic compounds, and flavonoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
